skill.name: get-started
skill.description: Show what Levels.fyi can do and suggest first questions. Use right after the plugin is installed, or when the user asks what Levels.fyi can do or how to start.
skill.summary: Introduce Levels.fyi and suggest personalized questions about pay, offers, and jobs without making initial tool calls.
skill.author: levels-fyi

security_audit.summary: Static analysis supplied no findings, so no finding verdicts are required. The reviewed instructions describe onboarding and defer tool calls until a user request. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential collection, or data exfiltration in the supplied skill.

content.user_title: Explore Levels.fyi Pay, Offers, and Jobs
content.value_statement: New plugin users may not know which compensation or job questions to ask. This skill introduces Levels.fyi and suggests three relevant starting questions.
actual_capabilities: Produce an onboarding reply under 120 words.
Suggest one starting question each for pay, offer evaluation, and job searches.
Tailor suggested questions using available context about role, company, level, city, or an offer.
Use predefined example questions when personal context is unavailable.
Explain the stated email and sign-in requirements without requesting either during onboarding.
Defer tool calls until the user asks a question.
limitations: This skill provides onboarding instructions, not executable salary analysis or job search tools.
It does not verify live pay data, job availability, or service access requirements.
Personalization depends on available context; fallback examples do not describe the user.
It does not sign users in, submit salary information, or upload resumes.

use_cases.title: Start Exploring Compensation
use_cases.description: Receive an introduction and a concrete pay question based on a known role, level, or city.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Offer Question
use_cases.description: Turn available offer details into a starting question about competitiveness or comparison.

use_cases.title: Begin a Focused Job Search
use_cases.description: Receive a suggested job question reflecting available preferences such as role, location, and compensation.
use_cases.target_user: Job seekers using the plugin for the first time

prompt_templates.title: Begin With the Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: I just installed the Levels.fyi plugin. What can I ask?

prompt_templates.title: Personalize the Starting Questions
prompt_templates.prompt: Introduce Levels.fyi for a Google L5 engineer in Seattle. Suggest starting questions about pay, offers, and jobs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Onboarding with role, level, and location

prompt_templates.title: Include an Offer
prompt_templates.prompt: Introduce Levels.fyi using my Stripe offer: $210,000 base and $400,000 RSUs over four years. Suggest pay, offer, and job questions.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Career Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my shared offer details and remote product manager preferences, introduce Levels.fyi. Suggest three relevant starting questions without running searches.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced onboarding using multiple available context details

output_examples.input: I just installed Levels.fyi. What can I ask?
output: Levels.fyi pay data and open jobs are available here, free and without signing in.
Example pay question: What does Google pay an L5 engineer in Seattle?
Example offer question: Is a Stripe offer with $210,000 base and $400,000 RSUs over four years competitive?
Example job question: Find remote product manager jobs paying at least $200,000 base.
Adding your salary or offer needs only an email; signing in is needed only to read your profile or upload a resume.

output_examples.input: I am a Google L5 engineer in Seattle considering a Stripe offer. Introduce Levels.fyi and suggest starting questions.
output: Levels.fyi pay data and open jobs are available here, free and without signing in.
Pay: What does Google pay L5 engineers in Seattle?
Offer: How does my Stripe offer compare with compensation for Google L5 engineers in Seattle?
Jobs: Find engineering jobs in Seattle that match my Google L5 experience.
Adding your salary or offer needs only an email; signing in is needed only to read your profile or upload a resume.

best_practices: Share only the role, level, location, or offer details needed to personalize your starting questions.
Treat fallback company names and salary figures as examples, not facts about your situation.
Choose a suggested question and ask it explicitly when you are ready for follow-up tools.
anti_patterns: Treating suggested questions as completed salary research or verified job results.
Providing passwords, authentication tokens, or a resume just to receive the introduction.
Assuming fallback salary figures describe your compensation or current market rates.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It introduces Levels.fyi and suggests three starting questions covering pay, an offer, and jobs.

faq.question: Does it search salaries or jobs immediately?
faq.answer: No. The instructions defer tool calls until you ask a question; this skill contains no search implementation.

faq.question: How are the questions personalized?
faq.answer: They use available context such as your role, company, level, city, or previously mentioned offer.

faq.question: What happens when no personal context is available?
faq.answer: It uses example questions about Google pay, a Stripe offer, and remote product manager jobs.

faq.question: Do I need to sign in for the introduction?
faq.answer: No. The introduction requests neither email nor sign-in. It states that profile access and resume uploads require sign-in.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists all three. Actual pay and job queries depend on the surrounding Levels.fyi plugin integration.
